note: Names, descriptions and grades match the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles, checked 2026-11-19. Hidden flags: 28 hidden (27 bronze, 1 gold). Targets are PSN's progress counters. Guides are our own words; specifics we could not confirm in two public guides are marked unconfirmed in the guide text.

trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and this one unlocks on its own. There is no extra task: the road is the five story chapters, the 100% Completion checklist, and the side and miscellaneous trophies below. PowerPyx rates the set 4/10 and about 200 hours, with one playthrough and no online trophies. Keep cheats off the whole run — using one disables trophies and saving.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Complete Gone Fishing, one of the first missions of Chapter 1 — the fishing trip that opens the story. It unlocks naturally as you play the opening missions, and it cannot be missed. It is the first trophy most players earn, and the only one anywhere near common on launch day.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 1. Story trophies unlock as the chapters end, so there is nothing extra to do and nothing to miss — just keep playing the main missions until the chapter closes. The chapters run in order, and free roam stays open after the story.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 2. Like the other chapter trophies it comes from playing the story through to the chapter's end. Nothing here is missable, and the chapter's optional missions are worth taking as they appear — several feed the side trophies below.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 3. Pure story progress: play the chapter's missions in order until it closes. Chapter 3 is also where Yasmani's jobs open up the Snap Gun, which the Sneakthief trophy wants, so take the optional jobs as they come.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 4, the last chapter trophy before the finale. Chapter 4 also opens the bank vaults through an optional mission — the vaults feed Maximum Withdrawal and the 100% checklist, so do that optional mission when it appears.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Complete the final mission and watch the credits roll. This is the story's end and the gold that closes the five chapters. After the credits you return to free roam, and the 100% Completion checklist appears under Progress > Stats — everything left is still available.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Complete Breakfast Run, a Chapter 2 story mission. It unlocks by playing the mission when it comes up in the story; there is no choice to make and nothing to miss. Mission trophies like this one are the story's waypoints — finish the mission and the trophy follows.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Complete The Cartel Heist, a Chapter 3 story mission. Play the mission through when the story offers it. It cannot be missed, and the heist itself is good practice for the bank vault robberies that Maximum Withdrawal asks for later.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Complete Child's Play, a Chapter 4 story mission. Story progress only — take the mission when it appears and finish it. Nothing about it is missable, and it sits in the chapter that also opens the bank vaults.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Complete Headliners, a Chapter 4 story mission. Finish the mission when the story brings it to you. Like every mission trophy it is unmissable, and it lands in the same chapter as Family Matters and Hi-Jacked.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Complete VCIA Takedown, a Chapter 4 story mission. Play it when it comes up. It cannot be missed. The airport is the same place Catch Me If You Can wants you to steal a jet from, so the area will feel familiar by the time you go back for that one.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Complete Operation Savage Glory, a Chapter 5 story mission. The last of the mission trophies before the finale. Finish the mission and it unlocks; nothing here can be missed, and the final mission follows soon after.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: Attain 100% Completion. After the credits, open Progress > Stats > 100% Completion: the checklist appears there, and everything you did during the story already counts toward it. PowerPyx calls it the hardest trophy, but the thresholds are lenient — it is closer to 60% true completion. You need 200 of 277 vehicles scanned, 100 of 255 animals studied, 50 of 66 weapons, and 70 of 80 challenges; only robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's quests need everything. Budget around 100 hours after the story. Nothing on the checklist is missable.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Complete 250 Stunts. Stunts are the jumps scattered across Leonida — any 250 of the 397 count, so you can skip the awkward ones. The 100% checklist wants 300, so keep going past this trophy if you are chasing A Long Road. A fast car and the map's stunt markers make this a long drive rather than a hard one.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each type of activity once. There are nine activity types — fishing, races, shooting ranges, drone races, arcade games, bowling, meditation, hunting and the other side games. Play one of each and the trophy pops; you do not need to win or finish any of them, just take part. Check the in-game activities list to see which types you have not touched yet.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges: 42 gold medals across 12 ranges. Each range has its own set of challenges, and gold means beating the top score band, not just finishing. PowerPyx notes the golds are not too difficult — practice a range until the pattern clicks, then move on. All 42 are needed for the 100% checklist too, so this one pulls double duty.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location: one win at each of the 14 spots. There are 42 drone races in total and the 100% checklist wants all of them, but this trophy only needs a single win per location. Learn each course's racing line, then win the rest for the checklist at your own pace.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races, out of 40. Winning the same race twice does not count, so work through the race list and tick off new ones. Any race type counts — mix road races, off-road and the rest to keep it fresh, and keep a note of which you have already won.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Cal texts you after a Chapter 1 mission and marks the fishing spot with a purple icon — head there, take the challenge and out-fish him. Fishing is one of the nine activity types, so this also feeds Master of None. It was one of the first trophies players unlocked on launch day.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game. Find an arcade cabinet in Leonida, start any game and play it through to the end. You do not need a high score — finishing is enough. Arcade games also count as one of the activity types for Master of None.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Andy's jobs open up during the story — take them as they appear and work through the strand to its last mission. Like the other character strands, the final mission can be picked up during cleanup after the story, so there is no rush and nothing to miss.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Kenton's jobs appear as his strand opens up — take them as they come and follow the strand to its end. Character strands stay open after the story, so finish the last mission whenever it suits you; nothing here can be missed.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. His five jobs start at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County after a Chapter 2 mission, and the strand stays open after the story. Drive out to the Mudclub, take the jobs one by one, and finish the last of the five.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida. Only some strangers count: Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete are among the ones that do, while Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy and Billy do not. Pick eight counting strands and finish each one to its end. Stranger missions appear as icons on the map — work through them during and after the story.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Randy's jobs open up during the story — take them as they appear and work through the strand to its last mission. The strand stays open after the story, so there is no deadline and nothing to miss.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Tyrone's jobs appear during the story — follow the strand through to its final mission. Note that Tyrone does not count toward Strangers & Freaks, but his own strand still ends in this trophy, and it stays open after the story.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida: 18 spots in 10 locations, with Jason and Lucia. This is the one trophy PowerPyx flags as potentially missable: the first meditation spot is offered at home in Chapter 1 and becomes permanently unavailable after that chapter, and it is not yet confirmed whether the trophy needs it — do it to be safe. The last spot needs Jason and Lucia playable together, which opens after Chapter 2. The 100% checklist only asks for 15 of the 18 spots, so the missable one cannot cost you A Long Road.
trophies.missableNote: Potentially missable: the first meditation spot, offered at home in Chapter 1, is gone after that chapter. Do it before Chapter 1 ends.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret's hunting quests start after Chapter 2 and are Jason-only — take them as Jason and follow the hunt to the animal it marks. The exact animal is not confirmed yet in the public guides, so check the quest marker in-game and hunt what it points to. Nothing here is missable.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets, out of 18. Cards are hidden around Leonida; each set is a group of cards, and three finished sets is all this trophy needs. The 100% checklist wants more of them, so keep collecting past the third set if you are chasing A Long Road.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. WAiNK is the in-game photo app: snap a photo at any mix of Landmarks (31), Curiosities (35), Sculptures (23) and No Flusher tags until you reach 100. Open the camera at a marked spot, take the shot, and the counter climbs. The spots are marked on the map, so this is a tour of Leonida more than a hunt.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. Challenges are the small feats tracked across the game — 80 in total, and 70 for the 100% checklist. Do any 50; the counter is a running total, so the driving, shooting and exploring you do anyway will fill much of it. The hardest challenges can be skipped entirely, since only 50 of 80 are needed here.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. Play with your partner alongside you, build the wanted level to 4 stars, then break line of sight and stay out of the search area until it clears. A fast car and the countryside help — the city keeps you boxed in. Your partner has to be with you when the level drops.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. With your partner beside you, rob a shop, then two more in a row, keeping the wanted level alive the whole time — if it drops, the chain breaks and you start over. Pick three shops close together, plan the route, and keep moving between them.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Scanning a vehicle with the in-game scanner marks it discovered — any 100 count. The 100% checklist wants 200 of the 277 base models, so keep scanning as you drive; every new car on the road is progress. Parking lots and traffic are the easiest hunting grounds.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Fill your Focus meter first, then trigger it in a fight with at least five enemies close together and drop them all before it runs out — an assault rifle makes this far easier than a pistol. Story shootouts with grouped enemies are the natural place to try it; if it does not pop, reload the checkpoint and try again.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA. Steal a passenger jet parked at a boarding gate at Vice City International Airport, take off and get about 1 km away. Expect police attention the moment you move — the runway is long and the jet is slow to build speed, so line up early and go.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: Kinda hot in these Rhinos. Steal a tank at Mile Zero Air Station and take out enemies from inside it. The base is guarded, so go in fast, grab the Rhino and use its cannon on the soldiers that come to you. Staying inside the tank is the point — its armour does the work.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. The quiet way in is the back door, and Yasmani's Chapter 3 jobs give you the Snap Gun for it — take those jobs first, then hit the store with the gun and slip out before anyone raises the alarm. If you are spotted, the trophy does not pop: leave and try again.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape. There are 8 vaults in Leonida, and the vaults open up with an optional Chapter 4 mission — do that mission first. Every vault robbery brings 4 stars, so have a fast bike ready for the getaway and a route planned before you go in. Five escapes is all this trophy needs; all eight count toward 100%.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Armored trucks run set routes around Leonida — stop one, crack it open and get away clean. A bank vault job also counts toward this trophy if you get away, so it may pop while you are working on Maximum Withdrawal.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida. The map starts fogged, and this trophy wants every corner of it uncovered — PSN counts 52 areas. A plane is fastest: fly a grid over the state and watch the fog peel back. It pairs naturally with the driving and flying you do for everything else, so it often pops on its own late in a playthrough.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang: one per gang, 9 gangs. Illegal operations are the gang-run businesses marked around Leonida — hit one belonging to each of the nine gangs. All 39 operations count toward the 100% checklist, so keep robbing past the ninth gang if you are chasing A Long Road.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. The exact trigger is not pinned down yet in the public guides — the description points to ordering a cocktail somewhere with a view of Ocean Beach. Try the beachfront bars at sunset and watch for the in-game prompt; we will update this guide when players crack the exact spot. Nothing about it is missable.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. The exact trigger is unconfirmed, but the description points to driving out through a showroom window — take a car inside a dealership showroom and floor it through the glass. If it does not pop, try another showroom; we will update this guide when the exact spot is confirmed.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Rob the Kingpin Bowling gang operation in Port Gellhorn, then lose the police. The robbery is the trigger, so treat it like any other illegal operation: hit it, then break away and stay clear until the wanted level drops.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. Max out Strength for both Jason and Lucia — working out together trains both at once, so take them to the gym as a pair and grind the stat to the top. It is a slow burn, so fold gym sessions into the gaps between missions.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Choices made (for better or worse). Do 500 actions that change your Criminal Profile — the running total of the choices you make in the world. It fills up on its own over a long playthrough, but do not push toward the Irredeemable profile on purpose: it is permanent. Play normally and let the counter climb.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. The exact trigger is not confirmed yet in the public guides — the description suggests something that only works on the second try. We will update this guide when players crack it; nothing about it is missable, so it will come with time.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? The exact trigger is not confirmed yet — the name points to something strange out in Leonida, the kind of oddity the series hides in the corners of the map. Explore the odd places and it will find you; we will update this guide when the trigger is pinned down.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. The exact trigger is unconfirmed, but the description points to knocking bowlers over with a melee attack from a moving vehicle — try a drive-by with a melee weapon past the bowling alley crowd. We will update this guide when players confirm the exact spot.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies and heists, and your contacts wash them for clean cash — it is a running total, not a single payout. Yasmani pays the most, so route your bills through him when you can, and the total climbs as you rob.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. It is a running total of everything you buy — weapons, clothes, food, upgrades — so it fills up as you play. Late in the game, if you are short, big-ticket buys like vehicles and weapon upgrades close the gap fast.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties: the 8 for sale, about $160,000 in total. The four garages the story gives you do not count — only the eight you can buy. Save up during the story and buy them as you go; the money for them comes naturally from missions and robberies.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app, which Moses gives you in Chapter 2. With the app open, register cars you find — you need free garage space for each one, so keep a slot open or buy another garage first. Ten registrations and it pops.
trophies.name: On the Spot
